errors.evidence: How Connected Papers (circa 2016) generates its graph visualizations, in particular how bubble sizes are determined
errors.description: The agent is trying to find information about how Connected Papers determined bubble sizes in 2016, which may not be relevant to the task of identifying the feature causing the largest bubble.
The agent misinterpreted the output of the tool as a direct answer to the question without verifying the context or the relevance of the citation count to the bubble size.

errors.evidence: the bubble size has been determined by the paper’s influence metric – essentially the number of citations it has received
errors.description: The agent assumes that the bubble size is determined by the number of citations without verifying this assumption with the actual tool documentation.
